observations.finding: GoalRecord publicly accepts status=ACTIVE/TRIAL/HOLD/DROPPED. GoalState.create enforces candidate-only input only when generation==0; for generation>0 it accepts a pre-adopted ACTIVE/HOLD state without any GoalStatusChange, patch, transition receipt, or adoption evidence. The exported GoalState constructor bypasses even the generation-zero candidate-only check.

The canonical suite explicitly seeds a GOAL_HOLD GoalRecord into GoalState.create at generation=2 to test resume. This demonstrates that noncandidate rehydration is an intended reachable API path, but the current contract carries no typed distinction between trusted replay/rehydration and arbitrary caller-supplied pre-adopted state.

observations.meaning: PASS means the negative counterexample reproduced: GoalState.create(generation=1, ACTIVE goal) and direct GoalState(generation=0, ACTIVE goal) both construct successfully without adoption-transition evidence. This is NOT component acceptance evidence.

counterhypothesis: Allowing noncandidate states at generation>0 may be intentional to rehydrate a previously validated lifecycle snapshot. That can be valid, but the current API does not bind such construction to trusted replay identity, a prior state digest, an admitted transition chain, or a separate rehydration type. Therefore arbitrary caller construction and trusted rehydration are observationally identical at this boundary.
contradictions: The active WP204 claim says caller-supplied goal candidates plus explicit adoption/hold/drop transitions, while current public construction can start from ACTIVE/HOLD state without an adoption/hold transition receipt.
GOAL_GENERATION != GOAL_ADOPTION is stated as a hard boundary, but the current constructor surface can materialize post-adoption state without proving the adoption operation.
proposed_state_change: Do not terminalize F2-WP-204 until genesis versus trusted rehydration is explicit. Keep ordinary creation candidate-only at every generation, or introduce a separately typed/fenced rehydration path that requires exact prior state identity/digest and admitted lifecycle evidence. Convert PR33 counterexamples into rejection regressions after repair.
completion_deficit: adoption/rehydration authority boundary is not explicit in current source
repository-CI success on the current canonical suite does not falsify this counterexample

no VPS or physical GRID10 runtime credit
next_exact_action: WP204 mutation owner re-enters current main, chooses and documents candidate-only genesis plus explicit trusted-rehydration semantics, adds rejection regressions for arbitrary pre-adopted construction, then reruns repository CI before any acceptance reconciliation.
